parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Limit value is number by default limit is 10. ex : ?limit=100

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Direction value is array / string with rule if array ex : ?direction[]=id&direction[]=name. if string ex : ?direction=id

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Direction value is array / string with rule if array ex : ?order[]=asc&order[]=desc. if string ex : ?order=asc

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search value is string with rule ex : ?search=Hitam

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language value is string with rule ex : ?language=id / ?language=en / ?language=cn

parameters.name: product_id
parameters.description: Product ID value is string with rule ex : ?product_id=1234567890

parameters.name: type_product_id
parameters.description: Type Product ID value is string with rule ex : ?type_product_id=1234567890

get.description: Retrieve a single product by its slug in the specified language

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: The type of the product to retrieve

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: The slug of the product to retrieve

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language of the product to retrieve (id/en/cn). Defaults to 'id'
